Alyssa / team — adding the CS + perf perspective and the concrete acceptance gates we'll validate during the Oct 28 run.

Acceptance gates (pass/fail):
1) Functional correctness: no more than 1% malformed responses vs. golden prompts (sample set attached in plan)
2) Latency: p50 < 80 ms, p95 < 200 ms during steady-state (600 req/s); p99 reported but not a pass/fail gate
3) Throughput: sustained 600 req/s for 10 minutes without error-rate increase > 0.5%
4) Stability: no JVM/OOM or GPU driver restarts; no host CPU > 85% for > 5m during steady-state (we'll collect infra metrics)
5) Degradation behavior: graceful latency increase under burst to 900 req/s with error rate < 3% and documented fallback behavior

Logistics notes:
- Auth: we'll use short-lived service tokens; Rachel to coordinate keys (please provide the endpoint and a test token before Oct 25)
- Test data: we'll use the file format in the workbook; Alyssa, can your infra team supply a sanitized sample by Oct 23?
- Reporting: Ben will upload raw metrics CSV and a short summary doc to the shared Drive link below.

If anything here is non-starter for Verdant's infra constraints, flag it and we'll adapt.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final results: Oct 28 run (summary + artifacts)

Team — attached is the run summary and raw artifact set (verdant_bench_results-20261028.csv). TL;DR: acceptance gates met for steady-state 600 req/s; stress observations noted.

Summary highlights:
- Steady-state (600 req/s, 10m): p50 = 72 ms, p95 = 180 ms, error rate = 0.12% — PASS
- Ramp to 900 req/s (controlled): p95 rose to ~310 ms, error rate increased to 1.9% during peak — expected degradation; system recovered to steady-state after throttle back
- No infra crashes, no GPU driver restarts; host CPU peaked at 78% during peak ramps
- Audit logs: we collected request-level traces and stored them to the linked Drive folder (redacted as requested).

Artifacts & links:
- Raw metrics CSV: verdant_bench_results-20261028.csv (attached)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3VerdantBench
- HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/VDNT-3981

Recommendation: accept on the condition that Verdant signs the standard performance acceptance addendum (we'll generate the DocuSign) and we run a short canary in production for 48 hours at 70% of expected peak traffic. If you agree, I'll open the addendum PR and coordinate legal + procurement.

Ben Carter
